title: 回文链表
description: 给你单链表的头节点 head，判断该链表的值序列是否为回文。O(n) 时间 O(1) 空间（不能复制整个链表到数组）。
ioFormat: 第一行 n，第二行 n 个整数。输出 true 或 false。

solutions.idea: 把链表值全部取出到数组中，再双指针头尾比较。写法极简，但 O(n) 时间 O(n) 额外空间，违背“原地”要求。
solutions.code:
import sys

class N:
    __slots__ = ('v', 'nxt')
    def __init__(self, v=0, nxt=None):
        self.v = v; self.nxt = nxt

def build(vals):
    if not vals: return None
    head = N(vals[0])
    cur = head
    for v in vals[1:]:
        cur.nxt = N(v)
        cur = cur.nxt
    return head

def is_pal_brute(head):
    vals = []
    cur = head
    while cur:
        vals.append(cur.v)
        cur = cur.nxt
    i, j = 0, len(vals) - 1
    while i < j:
        if vals[i] != vals[j]: return False
        i += 1; j -= 1
    return True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    head = build(vals)
    print('true' if is_pal_brute(head) else 'false')

solutions.idea: 把链表前半段压栈，再走后半段逐个弹栈对比。O(n) 时间、O(n/2) 栈空间。思路清晰，但仍未达到 O(1) 空间要求。

import sys

class N:
    __slots__ = ('v', 'nxt')
    def __init__(self, v=0, nxt=None):
        self.v = v; self.nxt = nxt

def build(vals):
    if not vals: return None
    head = N(vals[0])
    cur = head
    for v in vals[1:]:
        cur.nxt = N(v)
        cur = cur.nxt
    return head

def is_pal_opt(head):
    stack = []
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.nxt:
        stack.append(slow.v)
        slow = slow.nxt
        fast = fast.nxt.nxt
    if fast:  # 奇数长度，跳过中点
        slow = slow.nxt
    while slow:
        if stack.pop() != slow.v:
            return False
        slow = slow.nxt
    return True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    head = build(vals)
    print('true' if is_pal_opt(head) else 'false')

solutions.idea: 快慢指针找到链表中点，反转后半段就地，原地比较，再恢复（可选）。整个过程只用 O(1) 额外空间，是面试标准最优解。代码分两段：先找中点再反转再比较。
solutions.code:
import sys

class N:
    __slots__ = ('v', 'nxt')
    def __init__(self, v=0, nxt=None):
        self.v = v; self.nxt = nxt

def build(vals):
    if not vals: return None
    head = N(vals[0])
    cur = head
    for v in vals[1:]:
        cur.nxt = N(v)
        cur = cur.nxt
    return head

def reverse(node):
    prev = None
    cur = node
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.nxt
        cur.nxt = prev
        prev = cur
        cur = nxt
    return prev

def is_pal_best(head):
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.nxt:
        slow = slow.nxt
        fast = fast.nxt.nxt
    second = reverse(slow)
    p1, p2 = head, second
    ok = True
    while p2:
        if p1.v != p2.v:
            ok = False
            break
        p1 = p1.nxt
        p2 = p2.nxt
    reverse(second)
    return ok

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    head = build(vals)
    print('true' if is_pal_best(head) else 'false')
